namespace = ages_of_eu
namespace = abm_focus_picks

# Ars Belli: same-name replacement of vanilla in_game/events/ages.txt (listed in replaced_files.txt).
# GENERATED by .tools/scripts/focus_picks/generate_focus_picks.js - edit focus_data.js and re-run.
#
# Vanilla ages_of_eu.1 (fired by the hardcoded on_new_age) offered one adm/dip/mil focus via
# set_age_preference. That engine slot allows a single pick, so it is dropped entirely.
# Every age from the Renaissance on has two focus slots (Economic, Military), 3 branches each.
# Players pick in the Focus Picks panel (gui/shared/abm_focus_picks_panel.gui ->
# scripted_guis/abm_focus_picks_gui.txt). AI countries never pick, by design: a player who
# disconnects must not have the AI choose for them. A pick sets the country
# variable abm_focus_<branch>, which the branch advances use as potential.
#
# The notices abm_focus_picks.<n> (one per age, for the art) are country_events, NOT age_event:
# the age event window has exactly three cards bound to option keys adm/dip/mil and cannot show
# anything else. Vanilla's illustration_tags = { ages } only has art in that window, so the
# notices set a fixed image instead.

ages_of_eu.1 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes
	title = empty_text # like vanilla hidden events; without it the log reports a missing title
	desc = empty_text

	# Age of Traditions has no focus picks.
	trigger = {
		NOT = { current_age = age_1_traditions }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.6 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Player notice for age_2_renaissance: the new age's focuses are picked in the Focus Picks panel.
abm_focus_picks.2 = {
	type = country_event

	title = ages_of_eu.1.title
	desc = abm_focus_picks.notice.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/renaissance.dds"

	option = {
		name = abm_focus_picks.notice.a
	}
}

# Player notice for age_3_discovery: the new age's focuses are picked in the Focus Picks panel.
abm_focus_picks.3 = {
	type = country_event

	title = ages_of_eu.1.title
	desc = abm_focus_picks.notice.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/new_world.dds"

	option = {
		name = abm_focus_picks.notice.a
	}
}

abm_focus_picks.4 = {
	type = country_event

	desc = abm_focus_picks.notice.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/confessionalism.dds"

		name = abm_focus_picks.notice.a
	}
}

abm_focus_picks.5 = {
